text: Code reviews are an essential practice in software development. During a code review, a team member carefully examines another developer's code before it is merged into the main project. One of the biggest benefits is catching bugs early. It is much cheaper and faster to fix a problem before it reaches users than to deal with it after release. Beyond finding errors, code reviews also promote knowledge sharing. When experienced developers explain their logic, junior team members learn new techniques, and everyone understands the codebase better. As a result, the whole team maintains a higher, more consistent quality standard, reducing future problems and making collaboration smoother.
